patterns: Are you a human or a bot?
responses: I am the ShopEase AI Assistant! I can help you track orders, process returns, check refunds, view payment options, and answer store FAQs.

patterns: I want to check my delivery status
responses: I can certainly check that for you! Could you please share your 6-digit Order ID (e.g., #102345)? Or let me know if you want to cancel or modify this order.

patterns: I want to cancel my purchase
How do I cancel an order?
responses: Orders can be canceled before they are dispatched. Go to 'My Orders' -> Select Order -> Click 'Cancel Order', or provide your Order ID here and I will initiate the cancellation for you.

patterns: How can I return a product?
How many days do I have to return?
responses: We offer a hassle-free 14-day return and exchange policy for unused items in their original packaging. Would you like to know how long the refund takes after a return?

patterns: When will I get my money back?
How long does a refund take?
responses: Once your returned item is picked up and inspected, refunds are processed within 3 to 5 business days back to your original payment method.

patterns: What payment methods do you accept?
Can I pay with credit card?
responses: We accept UPI (GPay, PhonePe, Paytm), Credit/Debit Cards (Visa, MasterCard, RuPay), Net Banking, No-Cost EMI, and Cash on Delivery (COD) on eligible orders.
Standard shipping takes 3-5 business days and is FREE on orders above Rs. 499! Express 1-day delivery is available in select cities for Rs. 99.

patterns: How can I get a discount?
responses: You can use code WELCOME15 for 15% off your first order (up to Rs. 300)! Also check our 'Deals of the Day' banner for up to 50% off electronics and fashion.

patterns: I want to talk to a human
responses: You can reach our live human support team at 1800-123-4567 (Toll-Free) or email support@shopease.com. Our agents are available Monday to Saturday, 9:00 AM to 8:00 PM IST.
